Dehydrated Red Chilli Powder Manufacturer for Global B2B Supply

Red chilli powder brings heat and colour to snack seasonings, sauces, curry bases and spice blends, and food companies buy it in steady volumes. Tradenest Naturals manufactures fine milled red chilli powder for importers, distributors, restaurants and private label brands. Colour and pungency are matched to an agreed specification, so recipes stay predictable. As a dehydrated red chilli powder supplier, we support bulk orders, wholesale programs, custom packing, and export shipments from India. Raw material is carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers. The dried red chillies are cleaned, inspected, fine milled and sieved under controlled conditions. Buyers get a practical spice ingredient that performs the same way batch after batch. Our team also supports customers seeking a dehydrated red chilli powder supplier India, a dehydrated red chilli powder exporter, or a long-term ingredient partner for bulk dehydrated red chilli powder.

Product Overview

Dehydrated Red Chilli Powder is a finely ground spice made from dried red chilli pods. It adds heat, red colour, aroma, and flavour to food products. The powder can suit mild, medium, or hot formulations, depending on the chilli variety and agreed specification. We supply standard and customized grades for wholesale red chilli powder requirements. Buyers can request different mesh sizes, pungency levels, colour expectations, pack formats, and labelling solutions. In addition, our flexible manufacturing model supports dehydrated chilli powder wholesale orders for both established companies and growing brands.

Key product characteristics

  • Fine, free-flowing red chilli powder.
  • 60-100 mesh powder.
  • Controlled moisture for better storage stability.
  • No added colour or preservatives unless agreed in writing.
  • Suitable for food manufacturing, foodservice, and private label packing.
  • Available in retail, foodservice, bulk, and export-ready formats.

Manufacturing and Processing Method

Our process begins with raw material selection. We assess the chilli pods for maturity, colour, cleanliness, and general quality. Then, we remove foreign matter through sorting and cleaning steps. We dry the chillies to reduce moisture while protecting their characteristic colour and flavour. After drying, we inspect the material again before grinding. Fine milling produces the requested powder grade. We then sieve the powder to improve particle uniformity and flow. Finally, we pack each batch in food-grade, moisture-resistant packaging. Batch handling follows documented operating procedures. We maintain production records to support traceability and consistent supply. Moreover, customers can discuss custom processing requirements before commercial production. These requirements may include specific mesh, heat level, colour range, pack size, or private label design.

Quality Standards and Technical Control

Tradenest Naturals applies practical food safety and quality controls throughout procurement, processing, packing, and dispatch. These include careful raw material selection, moisture control, visual inspection, batch traceability, hygienic handling and packaging checks. Tradenest Naturals is an FSSAI licensed food business and an IEC registered exporter. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation. Third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. For shipping, we provide export documentation support, including the commercial invoice, packing list and certificate of origin. We review your document list before order confirmation. Customers should share their destination-country requirements before production. This helps us confirm labelling rules, documentation and any third-party testing you want to arrange. In addition, buyers may request pre-shipment quality checks based on an agreed specification.

Typical Specifications

The following values represent typical commercial specifications. Final values may vary by chilli variety, crop, season, processing method, and customer agreement. We confirm the final specification before production.
  • Mesh size: 60-100 mesh.
  • Moisture content: ≤ 8%.
  • Shelf life: 12 months in sealed packaging.
  • Appearance: Red to deep red, fine, free-flowing powder.
  • Flavour: Characteristic chilli flavour with mild to high heat options.
  • Ingredients: Red chilli only, unless a custom formulation applies.
  • Processing: Fine milled, after cleaning and drying, then sieved.

Applications

Dehydrated Red Chilli Powder works well in recipes that need consistent spice distribution. It blends easily with dry ingredients and liquid sauces. As a result, manufacturers can reduce preparation time and simplify inventory management.
  • Seasoning blends for snacks, namkeen, chips, and extruded products.
  • Instant noodles, pasta sauces, soups, and ready-to-cook meals.
  • Pickles, chutneys, curry pastes, marinades, and cooking sauces.
  • Meat, poultry, seafood, and plant-based protein marinades.
  • Restaurant, hotel, catering, and cloud-kitchen recipes.
  • Bakery savouries, crackers, biscuits, and savoury fillings.
  • Private label spice packs and retail cooking products.
  • Custom spice mixes, masala blends, and foodservice formulations.

Buyer Value

Our product helps commercial buyers improve process efficiency and recipe consistency. The powder eliminates much of the cleaning and grinding work required with whole chillies. Therefore, production teams can dose the ingredient more quickly and maintain repeatable batches.
  • Longer storage potential: Controlled dehydration supports better shelf-life management.
  • Cost efficiency: Bulk supply and concentrated flavour can support efficient formulation.
  • Consistent handling: Fine powder disperses easily in dry and wet recipes.
  • Flexible heat profiles: Buyers can request suitable pungency levels.
  • Reduced preparation labour: Ready-to-use powder simplifies commercial production.
  • Scalable supply: Flexible packing supports sampling, wholesale, and export programs.

Packaging and Shelf Life

We use food-grade, moisture-resistant packaging to protect the powder from humidity, contamination, light, and handling damage. Packaging includes an inner liner or suitable barrier layer, depending on the selected format and shipment requirement. Shelf life is 12 months from the manufacturing date when the product remains sealed and stored correctly. The final shelf life depends on packaging, moisture, storage conditions, and the agreed product specification. Each shipment carries relevant batch and date information for traceability. Available options include 100 g, 250 g, 500 g, 1 kg, 5 kg, 10 kg, and 25 kg packs. We also offer bulk bags, PET jars, HDPE containers, stand-up pouches, export packaging, custom printed packaging, and private label packaging. As a result, importers and brands can select a format that matches their sales channel.

MOQ, Samples, and Lead Time

Our minimum order quantity is 5 Kg. That keeps trial orders easy for new buyers and smaller brands. Samples are available on request. Private label and OEM projects need extra planning for packaging setup and artwork. Lead time is confirmed with each quotation, after specification, artwork and packaging are approved. Export orders may need extra time for documentation, freight booking or any third-party testing the buyer requests. However, the exact schedule depends on stock, season, order quantity, and customization. To request a sample or quote, send your required quantity, mesh size, heat level, destination country, packaging format, label needs, and target specification. Our team will review the request and suggest a suitable commercial option. Buyers may also share a sample specification or product benchmark for comparison.

Frequently Asked Buyer Questions

What quality documents do you provide?

Tradenest Naturals is FSSAI licensed and IEC registered. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. We follow raw material checks, moisture control, hygienic handling and batch traceability. Export documents are confirmed before order confirmation.

What are the typical mesh, moisture, and shelf-life values?

The powder is 60-100 mesh. Moisture is ≤ 8%, and shelf life is 12 months. Final specifications depend on the chilli variety and agreed contract requirements.

What packaging and shelf-life options are available?

We offer retail, foodservice, bulk, export, and private label packs. Common sizes range from 100 g to 25 kg, with bulk bags available. Shelf life is 12 months in sealed, moisture-resistant packaging under recommended storage conditions.

Can you provide private label or custom formulations?

Yes. Tradenest Naturals supports private label packing, OEM production, custom mesh, heat-level selection, seasoning development, and customer-specific formulations. We confirm technical and commercial requirements before production.

Why Choose Tradenest Naturals?

Tradenest Naturals combines ingredient manufacturing, export support, and practical food formulation knowledge. We serve food manufacturers, FMCG brands, hospitality businesses, distributors, and importers. Moreover, our broader capabilities include spice powders, dehydrated vegetables, seasoning blends, premixes, spray-dried ingredients, and custom food solutions. We focus on consistent quality, clear communication, flexible packaging, and long-term supply relationships. Contact Tradenest Naturals today for a sample, specification review, or quotation for bulk dehydrated red chilli powder.
